figures.caption: Table 1: Antibodies used for flow cytometry analysis 363 Spatial transcriptomic analysis 364 We performed spatial transcriptomic analysis as described earlier (Coccimiglio, Ibáñez-Molero 365 et al., in revisions). Briefly, we analyzed single-cell spatial transcriptomics data from archived 366 FFPE tumour tissues of four patients with stage III melanoma treated with neoadjuvant 367 immune checkpoint blockade at Amsterdam UMC. Two responders (with major pathological 368 response) and two non-responders were selected. Tissue sections were processed using the 369 Xenium platform (10x Genomics), including RNA extraction, probe hybridization, imaging, and 370 signal decoding to generate spatial gene expression data. Data were analyzed in R using 371 Seurat, with quality filtering, integration, clustering, and manual cell-type annotation based on 372 lineage markers. Low-quality and mixed clusters were excluded, and spatial re-clustering was 373 performed where necessary. 374 375 Statistical analysis 376 The statistical tests used are stated in each figure. GraphPad and R were used for the 377 analysis. 378 379 Acknowledgements 380 We thank our colleagues in the department of Molecular Biology and Immunology (MCBI) for 381 fruitful discussions and input. In particular, we thank Alsya Affandi and Joke de Haan for their 382 input on SIGLEC1 blocking antibody.
